intro: When space and security are key, KD Minor delivers. Its CRCA steel body ensures strength, while the low height makes access effortless perfect for everyday use in busy offices.

features.title: Space made to fit your needs
features.text: Adjustable shelves give you the freedom to store items of all sizes, keeping files neat, supplies organized, and every inch of space fully optimized.

features.title: Effortless setup, seamless moves
features.text: Designed for dynamic offices, this unit’s knock-down build makes moving, installing, or reusing smooth and efficient. Portable and practical it easily adapts to relocations, re-layouts, or new office spaces.

features.title: Polished finish, practical purpose
features.text: Clean lines and a refined finish create a professional look while delivering reliable, everyday storage for modern offices.

features.title: Trusted security made simple
features.text: Safety meets practicality—built-in cam lock ensures critical documents remain secure and dust-free.

features.title: Solid storage, slim profile
features.text: Tough on performance, sleek in design. It is built from premium CRCA steel, this compact unit delivers unmatched durability while maintaining a lightweight, space-efficient profile.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
